decision.reason: These are two different games in the same seven-game series between the Tortugas and Mets at Clover Park. The candidate covers Thursday's 17-3 game (published 2026-08-07), while the incoming article covers Sunday's 5-4 series finale (published 2026-08-09). The completely different scores (17-3 vs 5-4), different game days (Thursday vs Sunday), and the incoming article explicitly stating it's the 'Sunday finale' that decided the series 4-3 confirm these are distinct games within the same series.
